def make_grid(ncells, size, markers):
    n=ncells*(size+1)-1
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if r%(size+1)==size or c%(size+1)==size: g[r][c]=8
    for r,c,v in markers:g[r][c]=v
    return g
